name: OASIS
tagline: Open social simulations with one million agents.
description: A scalable, open framework for studying how information, norms, polarization, and collective behavior emerge in large populations of language-model agents.

name: SPAgent
tagline: A foundation agent for the physical and spatial world.
description: A general-purpose multimodal tool-calling framework that connects vision-language models to an open-ended ecosystem of perception, grounding, 3D, and generation tools.

name: Future
tagline: An open ecosystem for agentic, open-ended VLA policies.
description: Future develops embodied intelligence that decomposes goals into atomic skills, composes them on demand, and coordinates multiple effectors to solve tasks beyond its training distribution.

modules.name: MA-VLA
modules.description: Multi-arm collaboration through atomic skill assignment and compositional generalization.

modules.name: MACG
modules.description: A benchmark for multi-arm compositional generalization.

modules.name: Future-Hephaestus
modules.description: Open hardware infrastructure for building, connecting, and scaling embodied systems.
